name: E2E Técnico de Mensageria e Ciclo de Vida Omnichannel

security_capabilities_verified: Perimetric WABA webhook HMAC-SHA256 signature validation with timing-safe comparison
Perimetric AES-256-GCM envelope encryption with AAD prior to channel_webhook_inbox insertion
Lease fencing and heartbeat renewal during InboxProcessor execution preventing concurrent processing
Atomic relational genesis of contacts, commercial_threads, and messages under tenant-scoped RLS
Outbound transactional persistence { messages + outbound_commands + audit_events } with payload_fingerprint
Support for official WABA template metadata (name, language, components) end-to-end
Worker SKIP LOCKED claim and lease fencing dispatch via ChannelDispatchService to upstream adapters
Monotonic delivery status progression (sent -> delivered [rank 20] -> read [rank 30])
Cross-tenant isolation returning 404/403 fail-closed with zero database writes
Pre-transaction SSRF guard rejecting private and loopback URLs before opening database transactions

acceptance_criteria.evidence: Ingress de webhook WABA com assinatura HMAC validada gravado de forma encriptada AES-256-GCM em channel_webhook_inbox sob status pending.
InboxProcessor resgata e decodifica mensagem inbound, criando atomicamente contact, commercial_thread e message ('delivered', rank 20), transicionando inbox para processed.
Produção de mensagem de texto outbound via API Fastify persistida com RLS em messages, outbound_commands e audit_events com fingerprint SHA-256 de 64 caracteres.
Produção de template oficial WABA via API Fastify com preservação de template_name, template_language e template_components em outbound_commands.
Despacho pelo OutboxDispatcher via ChannelDispatchService para upstream com transição de status para sent e gravação de provider_delivery_events.
Loop tardio de status (delivered -> read) processado pelo InboxProcessor atualizando monotonicamente status_rank de 20 para 30.
Rejeição cross-tenant bidirecional com HTTP 404 fail-closed e zero gravações de comandos outbox.
Barreira anti-SSRF perimétrica rejeita URLs proibidas com HTTP 400 antes de abrir qualquer conexão ou transação com o PostgreSQL.
